articles.headline: Hong Kong Triathlete Vows to Keep Fighting After Painful World Cup Setback
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's home-soil hopes dimmed on 7 and 8 November when the World Triathlon Cup returned to the Central Harbourfront. Local favourite Bailee Brown endured a lacklustre showinga performance that fails to meet expectations令人失望的表現 in front of a home crowd, finishing well down the field as Russia's Diana Isakova claimed her third World Cup gold of the season. For Brown, the result was simply the latest chapter in a season she has described as unforgiving.

The 24-year-old's 2026 campaign has been plagued by setbackstroubled continuously by problems or misfortune屢遭挫折 almost from the start. She first fell ill with a combination of E. coli and norovirus after a Hong Kong race, then suffered a gruelling ordealan extremely difficult and exhausting experience艱辛的考驗 on a trail run that left a finger badly damaged, requiring four separate operations to repair. A subsequent bone stress injury forced her out of training for weeks. Her coach, Andrew Wright, admitted candidly that the stress injury had been entirely avoidableable to have been prevented with proper care完全可以避免 in hindsight, and that he bore some responsibility for pushing her training too hard.

Despite the accumulated toll, Brown insists she has not lost her unwavering resolvea firm determination that does not weaken堅定不移的決心 to keep competing. She describes triathlon as “brutal, unforgiving” yet says she still loves the sport that has tested her so severely. Brown will now travel to Jordan to draw the curtain on the seasonto bring something to its conclusion為賽季畫上句號 at the Asia Sprint Championships, hoping a better-prepared body can finally deliver a performance that matches her ambition after a year defined more by sheer perseverancecontinued effort despite difficulty純粹的堅持不懈 than by results.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港的主場捧盃希望在11月7日至8日世界三項鐵人賽重返中環海濱時黯然失色。本地名將Bailee Brown在主場觀眾面前錄得令人失望的表現，排名遠落後於奪得本季第三個世界盃金牌的俄羅斯選手Diana Isakova。對Brown而言，這個成績只是她形容為「無情」的一季中，最新的一章。

這位24歲選手的2026年賽季幾乎從一開始就屢遭挫折。她先是在香港一場賽事後染上大腸桿菌及諾羅病毒的雙重感染，接著在越野跑時經歷了一場艱辛的考驗，導致手指嚴重受損，需要接受四次手術修補。隨後的骨應力損傷更令她被迫停訓數週。她的教練Andrew Wright坦然承認，回想起來，這次骨應力損傷完全可以避免，並表示自己對訓練安排過於嚴苛負有部分責任。

儘管歷盡傷患折騰，Brown堅稱自己仍未失去堅定不移的決心去繼續征戰。她形容三項鐵人是「殘酷無情」的運動，但表示自己仍然熱愛這項嚴苛考驗她的運動。Brown現將前往約旦，在亞洲短距離錦標賽為賽季畫上句號，希望在身體狀態更好的情況下，終能交出一個配得上她野心的成績——在這一年裡，純粹的堅持不懈比成績本身更能定義她。

articles.headline: Hong Kong to Host IP Asia Forum and Entrepreneur Day to Boost Tech Careers and Start-ups
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong will throw open its doors to the region's innovators next week as the Hong Kong Trade Development Council stages the 16th Business of IP Asia Forum alongside the 18th Entrepreneur Day at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre on 19 and 20 November. The twin events will bring together roughly 100 speakers and more than 370 start-ups, inventors and support organisations from 14 countries and regions, offering a rare one-stop platforma single venue providing everything needed for a purpose一站式平台 for anyone hoping to build a career at the intersection of technology and business.

This year's headline addition is a dedicated “Tech Chapter”, designed to help inventors move beyond the laboratory and commercialise their ideasto turn an invention into a product that can be sold for profit將創意商品化 through technology transfer and structured entrepreneurship support. Organisers hope the new strand will act as a bridge between research and marketa connection linking scientific work to real commercial use連接研究與市場的橋樑, giving university teams and early-stage founders direct access to investors, licensing partners and potential clients they would otherwise struggle to reach.

For Hong Kong's young graduates, who have watched entry-level vacancies shrink as employers automate routine tasksto use machines or software to perform repetitive work previously done by people將常規工作自動化 with artificial intelligence, the forum offers a different route into the job market: building something of their own rather than waiting to be hired. Yet turning a patent or prototype into a sustainable business remains a formidable undertakinga task that is difficult and requires great effort艱巨的任務, requiring funding, legal know-how and market timing that few student inventors possess on their own. Whether such forums can meaningfully narrow the gap between invention and incomereduce the difference between creating something and earning money from it縮窄發明與收入之間的差距 for Hong Kong's next generation of entrepreneurs remains an open question.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港下星期將向全亞洲的創新者敞開大門，香港貿易發展局將於11月19日至20日假香港會議展覽中心舉辦第16屆「亞洲知識產權營商論壇」，並同場舉行第18屆「創業日」。兩項活動將匯聚約100位演講嘉賓，以及超過370個來自14個國家及地區的初創企業、發明家及支援機構，為任何希望在科技與商業交界發展事業的人，提供一個難得的一站式平台。

今年活動的焦點新增項目是一個名為「科技篇章」的專題環節，旨在協助發明家走出實驗室，透過技術轉移及有系統的創業支援，將創意商品化。主辦方希望這個新環節能成為連接研究與市場的橋樑，讓大學團隊及初創創辦人直接接觸投資者、授權夥伴及潛在客戶——這些資源他們單靠自己往往難以觸及。

對於眼見人工智能令僱主將常規工作自動化、入門職位日漸萎縮的香港年青畢業生而言，這個論壇提供了另一條進入職場的途徑：自行創業，而非坐等被聘用。然而，將一項專利或原型發展成可持續經營的企業，仍是一項艱巨的任務，需要資金、法律知識及準確的市場時機，而這些往往不是學生發明家單憑一己之力就能擁有的。這類論壇能否真正為香港下一代企業家縮窄發明與收入之間的差距，仍是一個未有答案的問題。

articles.headline: Hong Kong Weighs Funding AI-Generated Films Under Film Fund Review
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's government has signalled it will not automatically rule out channelling public moneydirecting funds towards a particular purpose撥款資助 towards artificial intelligence-generated films, as it carries out a sweeping review of the Film Development Fund. Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law told lawmakers on Monday that the review, first flagged in this year's Policy Address, will examine how far the fund's long-standing rules should adapt to emerging production technologiesnew technical methods that are only beginning to be widely used新興的製作技術.

The question was raised by lawmaker Lawrence Tang Fei, who pointed to rapid advances in AI film-making tools and the mainland's increasingly aggressive embracean eager and determined acceptance of something積極擁抱 of the technology. Hong Kong's fund already has some exposure to the field, having previously backed an AI Hub at this year's FILMART, suggesting officials are not starting from a position of complete resistance. Even so, Law stressed that key details remain unsettled, including whether a production would need to be wholly AI-generatedcreated entirely by artificial intelligence with no human-made elements完全由人工智能製作 to qualify, or whether hybrid works combining human and machine input could also apply.

The debate exposes a deeper tension at the heart ofa central conflict within a situation核心矛盾 the fund's mission. It has historically prioritised sustaining employment and livelihoods across the local film industry, from technicians to supporting actors, many of whose jobs could be rendered redundantmade unnecessary or unneeded, especially regarding a job變得多餘 by AI tools that can generate scenes without large crews. Whether Hong Kong can reward technological innovation while still safeguarding the livelihoodsprotecting the means by which people earn a living保障生計 of its film workers will likely shape the fund's final rules.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港政府表示，在全面檢討電影發展基金的過程中，不會一開始就排除撥款資助人工智能生成的電影。文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩星期一向議員表示，這項今年《施政報告》中率先提出的檢討，將研究基金一向的規則應在多大程度上適應新興的製作技術。

這個問題是由議員鄧飛提出的，他指出人工智能電影製作工具發展迅速，加上內地日益積極擁抱這項技術。香港的基金其實早已與這個領域有所接觸，曾經資助今年香港國際影視展的人工智能展區，顯示當局並非完全抗拒這項科技。即使如此，羅淑佩強調多項關鍵細節仍未確定，包括作品是否需要完全由人工智能製作才符合資格，又或結合人手與機器製作的混合作品是否同樣適用。

這場爭論暴露出基金宗旨的核心矛盾。基金一向以維持本地電影業的就業及生計為首要目標，涵蓋技術人員以至配角演員，而當中不少職位可能因為人工智能工具能夠在無需大量工作人員下製作畫面而變得多餘。香港能否在獎勵科技創新的同時，仍然為電影業從業員保障生計，將可能左右基金最終的規則。

articles.headline: Think Tank Urges Hong Kong to Overhaul Ticketing and Venue Rules to Win Back World Tours
articles.summary_html:
A newly published report has found that Hong Kong is being left off the itinerary of most major international concert tours, intensifying calls for the city to fix long-standing weaknesses in how it books and tickets live shows. Covering 95 Western artist tours between 2023 and 2026, the Hong Kong Future Economy Institute found that only 21.1 percent made a stop inincluded as part of a journey or series of events在行程中加插一站 the city, a figure dwarfed by Singapore's 49.5 percent and Tokyo's remarkable 74.7 percent.

The report points squarely at structural problems rather than a lack of demand. Rising ticketing frauddishonest schemes involving the sale of fake or non-existent event tickets票務詐騙 has eroded fans' trust in buying through official channels, while government-run venues such as the Hong Kong Coliseum operate on a rigid 12-month booking window with no provisional holding systema temporary reservation that can later be confirmed or released暫時留場安排, making it difficult for promoters to lock in dates far enough in advance to attract global superstars. Kai Tak Stadium, built partly to host exactly this kind of event, has so far welcomed only a single Western headliner, Coldplay, underscoring how chronically underusedused far less than its full capacity or potential over a long period長期未被充分利用 the venue remains for international tours.

For a city that has long branded itself an entertainment hub, the findings are a reminder that physical infrastructure alone cannot guarantee a share ofensure receiving part of something保證獲得其中一份 the lucrative “concert economy” without matching flexibility in how venues are run. The institute's recommendations now put pressure on authorities to decide whether loosening bureaucratic rulesmaking official rules and procedures less strict放寬官僚規則 is worth the risk of double-booking or scheduling conflicts at venues that also serve local community needs.
articles.summary_zh_html:
一份新發表的報告發現，香港被排除在大部分國際巨星巡迴演唱會的行程之外，令社會進一步要求政府正視香港在演唱會場地預訂及票務安排上長期存在的弱點。報告調查了2023年至2026年間95個西方藝人的巡演，發現只有21.1%在行程中加插一站來港演出，遠低於新加坡的49.5%，以及東京驚人的74.7%。

報告直指問題在於結構性缺陷，而非需求不足。日益嚴重的票務詐騙削弱了歌迷對正規購票渠道的信任，而政府管理的場館例如香港體育館，則採用僵化的12個月預訂制度，並無任何暫時留場安排，令主辦單位難以提早足夠時間鎖定場地，以吸引國際級巨星。啟德體育園部分原意正是為了舉辦這類盛事而興建，但至今僅接待過一位西方頭牌藝人Coldplay，反映場館長期未被充分利用於國際巡演。

對於一個長期自詡為娛樂之都的城市而言，這項研究結果提醒大眾：單靠硬件設施，並不能保證獲得其中一份利潤豐厚的「演唱會經濟」，還需要場館管理方式配合相應的彈性。智庫提出的建議，現時令當局面臨壓力，須決定放寬官僚規則是否值得冒上場館重複預訂或與本地社區需要發生時間衝突的風險。
articles.image_scene: Exterior of Kai Tak Stadium at dusk in Hong Kong, its distinctive curved roof lit up, a handful of anonymous concert-goers in casual clothes queueing at a ticket gate with phones in hand, empty rows of blue seats visible through an open gate, a food truck parked nearby, Kowloon Bay high-rises silhouetted in the background.

trends.headline: ✈️ Why Can't Hongkongers Afford Long Holidays? Threads Debate Blames Scant Annual Leave
trends.summary_html:
A blunt question posted on Threads this week — why Hongkongers, despite relatively high salaries and cheap flights, so rarely take long overseas holidays the way Europeans do — has snowballed into a heated debategrown quickly from something small into a passionate argument迅速演變成激烈的爭論, drawing hundreds of comments within days. Most commenters quickly rejected any suggestion of cultural preference, insisting the real culprit is a punishing workplace culturean extremely demanding and exhausting work environment嚴苛的職場文化 that leaves little room for rest.

Many pointed to capped annual leavea fixed upper limit placed on the number of paid holiday days allowed設有上限的年假, often frozen at around 14 days regardless of seniority, and to managers who frown upon extended absencesdisapprove of someone being away for a long period不滿員工長時間缺勤 even when leave is technically owed. Unable to disappear for weeks, many instead squeeze in exhausting weekend “flash trips”, flying out after work on Friday and clocking back into officially return to work, especially after an absence重新上班報到 at their desks on Monday morning, having barely had time to unpack.
trends.summary_zh_html:
本週Threads上一個直接的提問——為何香港人儘管薪酬相對較高、機票亦相宜，卻鮮少像歐洲人那樣享有長途海外長假——在數日內迅速演變成激烈的爭論，引來數百則留言。大部分留言者迅即否定這純粹是口味問題的說法，堅稱真正的元兇是嚴苛的職場文化，令人幾乎沒有喘息空間。

不少人指出問題在於設有上限的年假，往往不論年資都凍結在約14日左右，加上上司不滿員工長時間缺勤，即使假期理應享有亦然。由於無法抽身數週外遊，許多人只能擠出令人疲憊的週末「快閃旅行」，星期五收工後即飛往外地，到星期一早上又要重新上班報到，行李甚至還未來得及打開。

causes.label: Hong Kong's statutory leave minimum lags behind regional peers
causes.label_zh: 香港法定最低年假落後於區內同儕
causes.text: Hong Kong's statutory minimum paid leave starts at just seven days a year and rises slowly with service, far below entitlements common across Europe. Critics argue that without legislative reform raising this floor, employers face little pressure to grant the extended leave needed for genuine long-haul travel, however generous individual companies claim to be.
causes.text_zh: 香港法定最低有薪年假僅為每年七日，隨年資緩慢遞增，遠低於歐洲普遍的年假水平。評論者認為，若不透過立法改革提高這個下限，僱主根本沒有太大壓力批出足以應付真正長途旅行所需的假期，不論個別公司聲稱自己有多寬鬆。

causes.label: Older workers normalised overwork; younger staff are pushing back
causes.label_zh: 舊一代視捱更捱夜為常態，年青一代開始反抗
causes.text: Many older employees grew up believing that forgoing holidays signalled loyalty and diligence, a mindset some younger workers now openly reject online. The viral thread reflects a wider generational shift in which Gen Z employees increasingly treat rest as a right to defend rather than a privilege to apologise for taking.
causes.text_zh: 許多較年長的員工自小相信，放棄假期代表忠誠和勤奮，這種想法現正被部分年青員工在網上公開質疑。這場爆紅的討論，反映出更廣泛的世代轉變——Z世代員工日益視休息為應當爭取的權利，而非需要為之道歉的恩惠。

causes.label: Leave flexibility often depends on rank, not need
causes.label_zh: 假期彈性往往取決於職級，而非實際需要
causes.text: Commenters noted that senior staff can often negotiate extended leave with little friction, while junior employees fear that a two-week request will be seen as a red flag during appraisals. This uneven access turns long-haul travel into a marker of seniority and job security rather than something available equally to every worker.
causes.text_zh: 有留言者指出，高級員工往往能較輕易爭取延長假期，而初級員工則擔心一旦申請兩星期假期，會在考核中被視為負面標記。這種不均等的待遇，令長途旅行變成一種顯示職級及工作保障的標記，而非每位僱員皆能平等享有的待遇。

causes.label: Flash trips glamorise exhaustion rather than solving it
causes.label_zh: 快閃旅行只是將疲憊浪漫化，而非真正解決問題
causes.text: Some commentators pushed back against romanticising the Friday-night-flight, Monday-morning-desk routine, warning that squeezing a holiday into 48 hours barely counts as rest at all. Framing exhaustion as resourcefulness, they argue, lets employers off the hook entirely, distracting from the more uncomfortable conversation about genuinely reforming Hong Kong's leave entitlements.
causes.text_zh: 有評論者反駁將「星期五夜機、星期一返工」這種節奏浪漫化的說法，警告把假期壓縮在48小時內，根本稱不上真正的休息。他們認為，將疲憊包裝成「醒目變通」，只會讓僱主完全脫身，令人忽略更應正視的議題——真正改革香港的假期制度。

vocab.sample: Hong Kong's statutory leave entitlement remains among the lowest in the developed world.
Many employees only discover their full annual leave entitlement after reading the fine print of their contract.
A flash trip to Taipei over the weekend has become a popular escape for overworked professionals.

Critics argue that burnout culture, not low pay, is the real barrier to taking proper holidays.

Travellers on a compressed itinerary often spend more time at the airport than at their destination.
Presenteeism, the pressure to be seen at your desk, discourages staff from using their full leave.
Negotiating more paid time off is increasingly a priority for younger job seekers in interviews.
A single long weekend rarely gives commuters enough time to recharge properly before the next work cycle.

phrases.zh: 將休息視為應有的權利而非恩惠
phrases.sample: Younger employees increasingly treat rest as a right rather than a favour granted by employers.

phrases.en: romanticise an unsustainable routine
phrases.zh: 將不可持續的生活節奏浪漫化
phrases.sample: Online posts sometimes romanticise an unsustainable routine of back-to-back weekend flights.

phrases.en: shift the blame away from employers

phrases.sample: Framing exhaustion as cleverness can shift the blame away from employers who grant too little leave.

phrases.en: fall short of regional labour standards

phrases.sample: Hong Kong's statutory leave entitlement falls short of regional labour standards in several neighbouring economies.

phrases.sample: Some companies subtly penalise staff for taking earned leave by assigning them to high-pressure projects afterwards.

phrases.en: widen the gap between seniority and flexibility
phrases.zh: 擴大職級與彈性之間的差距
phrases.sample: Uneven leave policies widen the gap between seniority and flexibility within the same company.

phrases.en: normalise chronic overwork
phrases.zh: 使長期過度工作成為常態
phrases.sample: A culture that normalises chronic overwork makes even modest holiday requests feel like a risk.

phrases.en: question long-held workplace assumptions
phrases.zh: 質疑根深蒂固的職場假設
phrases.sample: The viral thread encouraged many young professionals to question long-held workplace assumptions about loyalty.

phrases.en: spark calls for legislative reform
phrases.zh: 引發對立法改革的呼聲
phrases.sample: Public frustration over limited leave has begun to spark calls for legislative reform.
